# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 81 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 81

Jesus said: "The one who has grown rich — let him rule. And the one who holds power — let him give it up."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Grown rich" — the process of becoming rich is emphasized
- "Let him rule" — kingdom/royalty compressed to its function
- "Give it up" — the renunciation as active release
